_comment: Baseline for scripts/check-dependency-gate.mjs. `total` is the deduplicated (name@version) package count of the published runtime graph — `dependencies` plus `optionalDependencies` — as resolved by the committed package-lock.json, computed via `npm ls --all --omit=dev --json`. `requiredOnly` is the same count with the optional `qrcode` subtree excluded (i.e. what a consumer gets with `--omit=optional`). Bump these numbers in the same change that knowingly grows the graph (a dependency bump, a new transitive dep upstream, etc.) and say why in the commit/PR — that is what makes an increase 'explained' per PLAN.md Wave 4 / D4.
methodology: npm ls --all --omit=dev --json, deduplicated by name@version, walked from package.json's `dependencies` and `optionalDependencies` roots only (devDependencies excluded).
